articles.title: Bhadrapada Amavasya 2026: Date, timings, puja rituals and significance of Pithori Amavasya
articles.description: Bhadrapada Amavasya: Pithori Amavasya in 2026 will be observed on September 10, a significant day for mothers. Devotees will pray for their children's health and long life, ensuring family happiness. The observance is also linked to preserving family lineage and household peace. This festival, falling in Bhadrapada, involves worshipping Goddess Pithori and the Sapta Matrikas. Ancestor worship rituals are also performed, honoring deceased family members.

For many young individuals, Mao's philosophies serve as not just historical insights but as tools for resilience. The complexity of his legacy elicits both national pride and awareness of past hardships, reflecting the current societal dynamics within modern China.

articles.title: U.S. Strikes 5 Iranian Oil Tankers, Iran Threatens Gulf Ports As Tensions Escalate
articles.description: The United States and Iran escalated tensions on September 8 following a series of military confrontations involving naval forces and oil tankers. U.S. Central Command said American forces destroyed five Iranian crude oil carriers after attempted missile attacks on a U.S. Navy warship over the previous two days. Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned that the United States would continue targeting Iranian tankers in response to attacks on American naval vessels. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards subsequently threatened to target ships in Kuwaiti and Bahraini ports hosting U.S. personnel and urged crews to evacuate. Iranian state media also released video allegedly showing the capture of an unmanned U.S. submersible near the Strait of Hormuz. Washington had not immediately confirmed the reported capture. Meanwhile, Rubio continued a diplomatic tour of Colombia, Peru and Ecuador, including discussions on trade with Colombia.
